sentences.en: They rarely spoke of the labour problem at their workplace.
sentences.zh: 他们很少在工作场所谈及劳动问题。

sentences.en: A country without enough labour force cannot be self sufficient.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的劳动力，一个国家无法自给自足。

sentences.en: Four factors of success are land, labour, capital and organization.
sentences.zh: 成功的四大要素是土地、劳动、资本和组织。

senses.zh: 支持工党的，与工党有关的
